name: A Nocturne of the Far North
subtitle: Song of the Welkin Moon: Interlude
description:
To defy fate, you may flee the clamor of the world and venture into the phantom night.
The moon's veil shrouds the silent river, while tranquil lanterns illuminate the path ahead.
Homeland is always there, calling out to every lost soul.

Hexerei: Secret Rite (Sucrose, Mona, Durin, Klee, Albedo, Venti, Fischl, Razor)
Before performing a score, you can choose from various "Specializations" to enrich your performance experience, such as increasing or lowering the difficulty, or taking on additional challenges.
"Specialization" effects can be applied to scores from official albums as well as pieces created by other performers.
Successfully performing a score with difficulty-enhancing Specialization effects will earn you the corresponding medal.
You can initiate Co-Op Ensemble on the Score Selection Page. (Also available in the Serenitea Pot).

In Co-Op Ensemble, all participants perform individually and compete to gain the highest rating. The initiator can select special options to increase or decrease the score's difficulty or create special challenges. Certain special options will not take effect in Co-Op Ensemble.
